_note: Checked-in Cline configuration for the M1 baseline. Cline stores its real settings in VS Code global state; step 50 currently reports these values for manual application via the Cline settings UI. Automating the write is an open M1 item.

rationale.model: M0 findings: 7B Q4_K_M / Q5_K_M are the largest models fully GPU-resident on the 8 GB host, ~44-52 tok/s at <=16k context. 3B is the fast fallback; 14B and 7B Q8 are offload-bound and unusable.
rationale.context: Keep working context <=16k tokens - the 32k KV cache pushes 7B past 8 GB VRAM and collapses throughput to ~1-5 tok/s.
rationale.autoApproval: Off for the baseline: a human supervises every run through the MVP (execution cadence, M3 reduced form).
